name: Dragon's Cr●wn Ishukan Meikyuu ~Bakemono no Soukutsu ni Mayoikonda Onna-tachi~
original_name: ドラゴンズ・ク●ウン 異種姦迷宮 ～化物の巣窟に迷い込んだ女達～
source:
A perverse adaptation of the fantasy action game Dragon's Crown!

A legendary treasure, the "dragon's crown", has the power to destroy worlds in a single night.
It exists somewhere in these ancient ruins, and wicked warlocks seek it.
A heroic party of four brave the labyrinth to stop them.

I am a lowly member of the wicked warlocks.
My ability is to control ghouls, ghosts and spirits.
It's up to me how I dispose of the the party. They're almost all girls!
This place is teeming with monsters I can use to humiliate them.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087177.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部恶趣味改编自奇幻动作游戏《龙之皇冠》的作品！

传说中的秘宝“龙之皇冠”拥有在一夜之间毁灭世界的力量。
它就藏在这片古老遗迹的某处，邪恶的术士们也正在寻找它。
一支由4名英雄组成的勇者队伍闯入迷宫，试图阻止他们。

而我，只是邪恶术士们手下一个卑微的小卒。
我拥有操纵尸鬼、幽灵与魂魄的能力。
该如何收拾这支队伍，全部由我决定。毕竟她们几乎全是女人！
这个地方遍布受我驱使的怪物，正好可以用来尽情羞辱她们。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087177.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
